integrity: All mathematical claims are supported by the accompanying complete proof; finite computational checks supplement rather than establish its unbounded quantifiers. External independent scientific validation is not represented.
scientific_limitations: Equal independent initial survival probabilities; undirected simple bipartite two-even-cycle bouquets sharing one vertex; deterministic degree-two pruning; no ecological dynamical or arbitrary-graph conclusions. Family-specific n=11 minimality only.
title: Single-crossing two-core robustness in degree-matched bipartite ecological networks
